frequency_question: How often do major partisan electoral integrity bills pass the Senate within a comparable window?
membership_rule: Includes major standalone federal bills altering voter registration, ballot access, or election administration that generate intense partisan division. Excludes routine appropriations, bipartisan technical fixes, or omnibus packages attached to must-pass vehicles.
window: Within a 314-day legislative window from introduction

cases.name: National Voter Registration Act Amendments / Related partisan pushes (historical baseline proxy)

coverage_note: 5 named; believed roughly 8 to 10 major partisan election reform pushes in this timeframe
known_gaps: Excludes minor committee-only variants that never reached floor consideration.
validity_reason: Institutional rules like the Senate filibuster remain stable across this timeframe.
